name: Pontianak City Run 2027
short_description: Pontianak City Run 2027 is on Sunday 31 January 2027 in Pontianak, West Kalimantan, over 5 km, 10 km, 21 km and the full marathon.
ai_summary: Pontianak City Run 2027 takes place on Sunday 31 January 2027 in Pontianak, the capital of West Kalimantan, which sits almost exactly on the equator. It offers 5 km, 10 km, a 21 km half marathon and a 42 km full marathon, with entry from Rp 98,000. A full marathon is rare in Kalimantan, which makes this one of very few chances to run the distance on Borneo's Indonesian side.

faqs.question: When is Pontianak City Run 2027?
faqs.answer: Sunday 31 January 2027, in Pontianak, West Kalimantan. Pontianak sits almost exactly on the equator, so conditions are hot and humid year-round and the start is very early in the morning.

faqs.question: Does Pontianak City Run 2027 have a full marathon?
faqs.answer: Yes. It offers 5 km, 10 km, a 21 km half marathon and a 42 km full marathon. A full marathon is unusual in Kalimantan, so this is one of the few chances to run the distance on the Indonesian side of Borneo.
